title: Kraliçe Olmak İstemeyen Patates
author: Nilay Şanlı
description: In the Land of Potatoes, a beauty contest is held every year. Starch’s mother signs her up, and Starch is selected as a contestant, but she does not want to be queen. Trying to impress the judges makes her uncomfortable, so she begins asking bold questions: What is beauty? Why does it matter, and who gets to decide? Starch realizes that she does not have to give others the power to judge her worth based on appearance.
english_title: The Potato That Refused to be Queen
